tracking: ADR-0359 §7 (lane E40): API-only goal-alignment routes, awaiting the screens on #453

gaps.GET /v1/goal-alignment/purposes/:identit: reads an agent identity's declared purpose (its tools and allowed actions), or none
gaps.PUT /v1/goal-alignment/purposes/:identit: declares or changes an agent's purpose (widening is a step-up relaxation; audited)
gaps.GET /v1/goal-alignment/findings: pages goal-alignment findings (shadow), newest first, filtered by status, identity or divergence
gaps.PUT /v1/goal-alignment/findings/:finding: acknowledges or dismisses a goal-alignment finding (audited)
